# IMouse.Clicked event

Raised on the game's thread once per frame, after the game's update, when the left button was released: a click, as the game's menus read it.

```csharp
public event EventHandler<EventArgs>? Clicked;
```

## Remarks

The game's own readers see the same click. In a Solo run's pause menu, a click anywhere runs the pause menu's highlighted entry, and a mouse move clears that highlight.
